performance.driver: Consolidated revenues in the three months ended September 30, 2026 were $143 million higher than the three months ended September 30, 2025 due to increases in the High CV Thermal, Metallurgical, PRB and Core Marine Terminal segments of $66 million, $63 million, $9 million and $5 million, respectively.

Total revenue increased in the third quarter and first nine months of 2026 compared to the same periods in 2025, driven by increases in data-driven marketing revenue of $13.9 million in the third quarter and $49.0 million in the first nine months of the year, reflecting strong demand for customer acquisition marketing activities, particularly from our financial institution partners.

Sales to the Energy & Process markets decreased $2,620, or 6%, primarily due to push outs on large capital project activity, partially offset by growth in New Energy markets, which increased $2,232, or 150%, from the prior year period, as well as the FlackTek acquisition.

Operating income increased 28.4% and 18.0%, respectively, during the three and six months ended September 26, 2026 as compared with the same periods of fiscal 2026. The increase during the three and six months ended September 26, 2026 was primarily due to favorable product mix across all business units, as well as decreased amortization of fair value inventory step-up related to the acquisition of Advanced Cooling Therapy, Inc., d/b/a Attune Medical (“Attune Medical”) and a decrease in impairment of intangible assets.

Net Sales Net sales for the 13-week period ended September 27, 2026 increased $3.2 million, or 2.3%, to $141.6 million, as compared to $138.4 million for the 13-week period ended September 28, 2025. The increase was primarily driven by improved price realization of approximately $5.0 million and incremental net sales from the HRX acquisition of approximately $2.4 million, partially offset by lower sales volume of approximately $4.2 million compared to the prior year period primarily the result of our portfolio rebalancing efforts.

Revenue Revenue increased by $32.5 million to $55.1 million during the three months ended September 30, 2026 from $22.6 million during the three months ended September 30, 2025 primarily due to the inclusion of a full quarter of passenger revenue from our Blade offering in 2026, compared to approximately one month in 2025 following the August 29, 2025 acquisition, partially offset by lower government flight services revenue from DOD agencies.

Revenue for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 was $632.2 million and $669.2 million, respectively, representing a decrease of $37.0 million, or 5.5%. The decrease was driven by the segment factors described below.

Net sales of $2.4 billion for the three months ended September 30, 2026 increased 22%, year over year, compared to the three months ended September 30, 2025, driven by growth across all operating segments.

Net sales decreased $0.4 million, or less than 1%, to $975.3 million for the three months ended September 27, 2026 compared to $975.6 million for the three months ended September 28, 2025. The decrease was driven by lower sales to the RV and MH markets, partially offset by increased sales to the powersports, marine, and industrial markets.

Net revenues increased by $182.6 million, or 9.1%, to $2.193 billion during the three months ended September 26, 2026 as compared to the three months ended September 27, 2025, reflecting growth across our reportable segments, including unfavorable foreign currency effects of $9.5 million.

Net sales decreased 1.6% for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to prior year, driven by lower financial volume and unfavorable foreign currency impacts, partially offset by favorable price and sales mix.

Net sales of $827 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 increased by 18%, compared to $699 million for the same period in 2025. The increase is primarily due to both higher sales volumes and average selling prices of TiO2 and zircon.

Operating income of $190.8 million increased by $79.4 million, or 71.3%, in the third quarter of 2026 as compared to the third quarter of 2025. This increase was primarily driven by tariff refunds, favorable price realization, sales volume leverage and productivity partially offset by inflation. ​ In discussing our results of operations, segment earnings is the GAAP performance measure used by our chief operating decision-maker (“CODM”) to assess and evaluate segment results.

Revenue increased by $25.2 million in our personal care segment, increased by $0.1 million in our hospice segment and increased by $0.1 million in our home health segment during the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to the same period in 2025. The increase in our personal care segment was primarily attributable to organic growth in billable hours combined with the HomeCourt Acquisition, the Gold Horses Acquisition and the Helping Hands Acquisition.

Total revenues increased 0.5% to $17.35 billion in the third quarter of 2026 compared to the third quarter of 2025, primarily due to higher auto and homeowners insurance policies in force, homeowners insurance average premium and net investment income, partially offset by net losses on investments and derivatives.

Operating income increased $14.9 million and $29.3 million for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, respectively, compared to the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025. The increase was primarily driven by higher sales and favorable mix associated with the additive growth noted above, while the benefit of cost savings from productivity and restructuring actions offset higher merit and variable compensation costs.

performance.driver: Revenues increased 4% on an organic basis primarily due to organic growth in AMS and DRS revenue, inflation-based price increases, and BGS revenue.

Total sales and revenues for the third quarter of 2026 were $20.682 billion, an increase of $3.044 billion, or 17 percent, compared with $17.638 billion in the third quarter of 2025. The increase was primarily due to higher sales volume of $2.2 billion and favorable price realization of $663 million.

Net sales increased by $47.0 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 as compared to the three months ended September 30, 2025, primarily as a result of current year acquisitions and increased demand for EOD products.
Net sales increased 5.4% to $2.0 billion in the third quarter of 2026. The growth in net sales was primarily the result of annual pricing actions with additional contribution from higher volumes.

Revenue for the nine months ended September 26, 2026 decreased $38.5 million, or 1.3%, to $2,982.6 million compared to $3,021.2 million in the corresponding period in 2025. The decrease in revenue for both the three and nine months ended September 26, 2026 was primarily due to a decrease in Manufacturing and RMS revenue due to the CDMO and Cell Solutions Divestiture and DSA revenue driven by the European Discovery Divestiture, compared to the corresponding period in 2025.

Operating profit decreased by $16.2 million, or 19.8%, to $65.7 million in 2026. The decrease was driven by acquisition related amortization associated with the Antares Vision acquisition, the impact of lower volumes in CPI, and unfavorable mix across both segments.

Sales and marketing expense increased by $7.1 million, or 20%, to $42.2 million during the three months ended September 30, 2026, from $35.1 million in the prior-year period. This increase was mainly due to increased personnel costs of $3.7 million, including $1.1 million related to a bonus plan tied to DAU growth and increased advertising costs of $2.6 million.

Net revenues increased by $9.0 million, or 13.0%, to $78.0 million in the three months ended September 30, 2026 from $69.0 million in the three months ended September 30, 2025, primarily due to higher Jeuveau® and Evolysse® sales.

Operating income Operating income for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 increased $304 million and $892 million, respectively, when compared to the same periods in 2025 due to the previously described quarter-to-quarter and period-to-period changes.

Sales revenue was $116.9 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, an increase of $46.9 million, or 67%, compared with $70.0 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025. The increase was primarily driven by higher sales of downhole components of approximately $21.1 million, including $18.6 million of incremental sales revenue generated from the Valiant Acquisition, which was completed in March 2026 and therefore was not included in the three months ended September 30, 2025.

Income from Operations As a result of the factors discussed above, income from operations increased by $10.2 million to income from operations of $35.1 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 as compared to $24.9 million in the prior year period.

Revenue was $546.5 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $451.4 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025, an increase of $95.1 million, or 21%. The increase in revenue was primarily attributable to expanded use of our platform and our portfolio of product suites by existing customers.

Net Sales For the three months ended September 30, 2026, net sales decreased 1.3%, or 0.6% on a constant currency basis, compared to the three months ended September 30, 2025. The decrease was due to lower net sales in FootJoy golf wear and Golf gear, primarily related to lower sales volumes, partially offset by higher net sales in Titleist golf equipment, primarily due to higher sales volumes and average selling prices in golf balls.
